biggest_catch: BetaFamily's official pages never state a concrete current tester pay rate — the $10 figure is a buyer-budget example for customers, not a promised tester wage.
catches: The official FAQ says testers 'can earn money' and shows a customer example of rewarding 10 testers $10 — that is an illustration for buyers, not a current tester rate.
Official terms only set a $50 cash-out threshold for aggregate Testing Fees, not a per-test rate.
The current live beta listing found (StockSizer) offers free Pro access, not cash — variable rewards per listing.
No current official paid test listing with a concrete tester amount was found.
